items.title: 川普對無人機徵收100%關稅 料加深美中科技脫鉤
items.title_en: Trump Imposes 100% Tariff on Drones, Likely Deepening US-China Tech Decoupling
paras: 川普政府周四(13日)宣布，將對進口無人機及其零部件徵收最高達 100% 的關稅。此舉被視為美國減少對外國供應商依賴、保護本土產業的重大升級，並可能加速美中兩國在無人機供應鏈上的「脫鉤」進程。
根據白宮公告，這項關稅政策採取分級制：重量超過 25 公斤或具備特定性能的重型無人機將面臨 100% 的最高稅率；較小型的無人機則徵收 25% 的關稅。
為了鞏固與盟友的關係，美國對特定貿易夥伴提供了優惠：來自歐盟、日本、瑞士及台灣的無人機，若硬體與技術皆源自當地或美國，稅率將降至 15%，而英國則適用 10% 的稅率。多數關稅將在簽署後 21 天內生效，部分非敏感零部件則有 180 天的緩衝期。
此次決策是依據《1962年貿易擴張法》第 232 條，以國家安全為由發起調查後制定的。商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)指出，美國對外國無人機系統的依賴已達「實質性」程度，對國家安全構成風險。
川普在公告中強調，無人機系統對美國的國家與經濟安全至關重要。特別是俄烏戰爭充分展現了無人機在現代混合戰爭中的軍事效能，促使華府更具緊迫感地去扶持國內產業，避免在關鍵技術上受制於人。
雖然官方聲明未直接點名中國，但目標顯然直指全球最大的無人機製造國。在此之前，聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)已採取行動阻止大疆創新(DJI)等新機型進口，大疆去年曾占據美國 70% 的商用市場。專家分析，美中雙方正滑向特定類型無人機的「硬脫鉤」，這已成為兩國在基本貿易協定下持續進行低層級對抗的一部分。
受此政策激勵，美國本土無人機製造商如 AeroVironment 與 Aevex Corp 的股價在消息公布後大幅跳升。然而，中國方面也已展開反擊，對軍用無人機及關鍵技術實施「逐案審查」的出口管制。
paras_en: The Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 13th) that it will levy tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and their components. The move is seen as a major upgrade in the United States’ effort to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and protect domestic industry, and it could accelerate the “decoupling” of the US and China in the drone supply chain.

According to the White House announcement, the tariff policy uses a tiered system: heavy drones weighing more than 25 kilograms or possessing certain capabilities will face the maximum 100% rate, while smaller drones will be subject to a 25% tariff.

To strengthen ties with allies, the United States is offering preferential rates for specific trading partners: drones from the EU, Japan, Switzerland and Taiwan that are wholly sourced in hardware and technology from the local market or the United States will see the rate reduced to 15%, and the United Kingdom will receive a 10% rate. Most tariffs will take effect within 21 days of signing, with a 180‑day grace period for certain non‑sensitive components.

The decision is based on Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, invoked on national‑security grounds after an investigation. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said U.S. reliance on foreign drone systems has reached a “substantial” level that poses a risk to national security.

In the announcement, Trump stressed that drone systems are critical to America’s national and economic security. The Russia‑Ukraine war has highlighted the military effectiveness of drones in modern hybrid warfare, giving Washington a heightened sense of urgency to support domestic producers and avoid dependence on critical technology.

Although the official statement did not name China directly, the target is clearly the world’s largest drone manufacturer. Previously, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) moved to block new models from DJI and other firms; DJI accounted for about 70% of the U.S. commercial drone market last year. Experts say the U.S. and China are moving toward a “hard decoupling” of certain drone types, becoming part of a low‑level confrontation that persists despite broader trade agreements.

The policy spurred a sharp rise in the share prices of U.S. drone makers such as AeroVironment and Aevex Corp after the news broke. China, meanwhile, has begun retaliating with case‑by‑case export controls on military drones and key technologies.

items.title: 外資本周天天買超共2061億元  最青睞力積電連4天加碼逾31萬張
items.title_en: Foreign Capital Buys NT$206.1 Billion in a Week, Favoring Powerchip
paras: 台股今(14)日開高走低，下跌210點作收，終場收45,811點，成交金額略微放大至1.06兆元。外資單日買超453億元，累計本周 5個交易連續買超5日買超達2,061億元，其中看好記憶體回溫、代工價格調漲，單日加碼力積電(6770-TW) 14.49萬張居完 ，連 4買超共31.63萬張。
三大法人操作部分，外資單日買超453.51億元、投信買超71.96億元、自營商賣超16.61億元，三大法人合計共買超508.86億元。期貨部位，外資期貨空單減少1,034口，累計為8.51萬口。

今日外資單日買超前10名中，外資買超力積電14.49萬張居冠，其次買進主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)9.52萬張、主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)5.86萬張、華邦電5.58萬張、仁寶4.78萬張、群創3.96萬張、元大台灣50(0050-TW)3.58萬張、主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)2.77萬張、主動凱基台灣(00407A)2.7萬張、寶成2.11萬張。外資今日也調節台積電由連5買轉賣3,024張。
外資單日賣超前10名中，賣超國巨*2.22萬張居冠、其次賣超中鋼1.89萬張，也大賣金融股玉山金1.73萬張、臺企銀1.64萬張、華航1.63萬張、長榮航1.61萬張、國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)1.48萬張、元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)1.12萬張、南亞科1萬張、元大金9,277張。
投信單日買超前10名中共9名皆為金融股，台新新光金、凱基金同為2.5萬張最多、玉山金1.83萬張、兆豐金1.55萬張、第一金1.46萬張、永豐金1.44萬張、華南金1.16萬張、元大金5,100張、華邦電3,770張、富邦特選高股息30(00900-TW)2,500張。
投信單日賣超前10名，則以電子權值股為主，大賣聯電5,627張、大成鋼5,000    張、日月光投控3,770張、緯創2,862張、鴻海2,552張、昇陽半導體1,544    張、南亞1,491張，賣景碩、勤誠、華通。
法人表示，台股今日呈現開高走低格局，指數正挑戰前波歷史高點壓力區，技術面上今日台股漲多拉回整理，目前在台股波動率走低態勢不變下，續作高檔整理，短線台股的拉回仍可以樂觀看待。籌碼布局上觀察，外資期現貨樂觀布局，整體籌碼面略為樂觀。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market opened high and closed low today, with the index falling 210 points to 45,811. The trading volume increased slightly to NT$1.06 trillion. Foreign investors bought a net NT$45.35 billion, making it the fifth consecutive day of net buying, with a total of NT$206.1 billion for the week. They were optimistic about the memory chip industry's rebound and the increase in foundry prices, and bought 144,900 shares of Powerchip (6770-TW) on the day, with a total of 316,300 shares over four days.

In terms of the operations of the three major institutional investors, foreign investors bought a net NT$45.35 billion, while investment trusts bought a net NT$7.2 billion, and dealers sold a net NT$1.66 billion. The total net buying of the three major institutional investors was NT$50.89 billion. In the futures market, foreign investors reduced their short positions by 1,034 contracts, with a total of 85,100 contracts.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net buying by foreign investors, Powerchip ranked first with 144,900 shares, followed by Fubon TWSE Taiwan 50 (00981A-TW) with 95,200 shares, Fubon Taiwan 50 (00403A-TW) with 58,600 shares, and other stocks. Foreign investors also adjusted their holdings of TSMC, selling 3,024 shares.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net selling by foreign investors, China Steel ranked first with 22,200 shares, followed by other stocks such as Yuanta Financial and EVA Airways. Foreign investors also sold a significant number of shares in the financial sector.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net buying by investment trusts, all were in the financial sector, with Taiwan Shin Kong Financial and Cathay Financial both buying 25,000 shares, followed by other stocks such as Yuanta Financial and Mega Financial.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net selling by investment trusts, most were in the electronics sector, with United Microelectronics selling 5,627 shares, followed by other stocks such as AU Optronics and Pegatron.

Institutional investors said that the Taiwan stock market presented a pattern of opening high and closing low today, with the index challenging the historical high point pressure zone. From a technical perspective, the market is still in a state of low volatility, and the current high-level adjustment is expected to continue. The layout of the chips is still optimistic, and the overall chip layout is slightly optimistic.

items.title: 台灣家庭所得差距達6.17倍 創14年新高
items.title_en: Taiwan Household Income Gap Reaches 6.17 Times, Sets 14-Year High
paras: 主計總處今(14)日公布114年家庭收支調查結果，114年可支配所得最高20%家庭平均每戶244.9萬元，年增3.9%，最低20%家庭平均每戶39.7萬元，年增3.5%，差距達6.17倍創14年來新高。
而在納計政府對家庭移轉收支(社福及租稅)前，114年每戶五等分位所得差距倍數7.49倍，年增0.11倍。
主計總處表示，由於各級政府對家庭提供各項補助，包括低收入戶生活補助、中低收入老人生活津貼、老農津貼、育兒津貼、各項社會保險保費補助等，縮小所得差距1.18倍，另家庭對政府移轉支出也縮小所得差距0.15倍。
主計總處統計，114年全體家庭平均每戶所得總額152.9萬元，年增3.3%，每戶可支配所得平均數121.0萬元，年增3.9%，每人平均數45.0萬元，增7.4%。
若以中位數衡量，114年每戶可支配所得中位數為101.8萬元，年增3.4%，每人中位數為36.7萬元，增3.2%。
而114年全體家庭平均每戶消費支出92.0萬元，年增3.6%，平均每戶儲蓄29.0萬元，年增4.9%。
就消費支出內容觀察，以住宅服務、水電瓦斯和其他燃料占24.1%為最高，其次為食品飲料及菸草占15.4%，另隨著國人平均壽命延長，衛生保健觀念增強，醫療保健支出占14.1%。
paras_en: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics announced today (14th) the results of the 2023 household income and expenditure survey. The top 20% of households with the highest disposable income averaged NT$2,449,000, a 3.9% increase from last year. The bottom 20% of households averaged NT$397,000, a 3.5% increase from last year, with a gap of 6.17 times, a 14-year high.

Before accounting for government transfers to households (social welfare and taxes), the income gap between the top 20% and the bottom 20% of households was 7.49 times in 2023, a 0.11 times increase from last year.

The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics stated that due to various government subsidies provided to households, including low-income household living subsidies, middle- and low-income elderly living allowances, old farmer subsidies, childcare subsidies, and various social insurance premium subsidies, the income gap was narrowed by 1.18 times. Additionally, household government transfers also narrowed the income gap by 0.15 times.

According to the statistics, the average household income in 2023 was NT$1,529,000, a 3.3% increase from last year. The average disposable income per household was NT$1,210,000, a 3.9% increase from last year. The average income per person was NT$450,000, a 7.4% increase from last year.

Using the median to measure, the average disposable income per household in 2023 was NT$1,018,000, a 3.4% increase from last year. The average income per person was NT$367,000, a 3.2% increase from last year.
The average household expenditure in 2023 was NT$920,000, a 3.6% increase from last year. The average household savings was NT$290,000, a 4.9% increase from last year.

Looking at the composition of household expenditure, the highest was residential services, water, gas, and other fuels at 24.1%, followed by food, beverages, and tobacco at 15.4%. With the average lifespan of the Taiwanese people increasing and health awareness improving, medical and health care expenditure accounted for 14.1%.

items.title: 定義「Agent 的 Android 時刻」？DeepSeek發布Harness框架
items.title_en: Defining 'Agent's Android Moment'? DeepSeek Releases Harness Framework
paras: DeepSeek 13日正式發表旗下首款 AI 代理人(Agent)開發框架「DeepSeek Harness」(以下簡稱 DSH)開發者預覽版，並同步推出針對 Agent 性能優化的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 模型。該專案採 MIT 協議開放原始碼，在發布短短 12 小時內，GitHub 標星數即突破 5 萬，展現開發者社群的高度關注。

「一切皆外掛」的模組化設計

DSH 的核心設計理念為「一切皆外掛(Plugin)」。該框架基於 Cordis 外掛系統建構，將模型、工具、沙箱、使用者介面(UI)甚至代理人運行的主迴圈(Agent Loop)全部外掛化。
DeepSeek 官方將模型比喻為「大腦」，而將 Harness 視為「手腳」，強調 Agent 的價值在於交付完成的任務，而非僅是文字對話。
專案負責人崔添翼指出，目前的 0.1.0 版本僅是面向開發者的預覽版，仍處於極早期階段，其介面與外掛生態仍在快速演化中。他將 DSH 比喻為「超級樂高汽車」，官方提供的 Coding Agent 僅是一套預設配置，開發者可自由更換引擎、輪胎或加裝模組，甚至拼湊出完全不同的形態。

「自進化軟體」的潛力與爭議

與 DSH 同步發表的還有一篇長達 88 頁的技術論文，提出「時空可組合性」範式，試圖讓 Agent 在無需人工介入下持續生成與替換元件。早期內測使用者 Jiayuan (JY) Zhang 認為，DSH 已具備「自進化軟體」的雛形，Agent 能現場編寫並掛載外掛以獲取新能力。
然而，這項特性也引發業界辯論。開發者寶玉 (@dotey) 則持保留意見，認為「軟體自進化」可能是假議題，因為軟體需要嚴謹的設計與驗證，過度自動化恐導致混亂。他同時點出 DSH 目前的進入門檻較高，啟動需依賴 Node.js 工具鏈，對非工程師的使用者並不友善。

透明化日誌與商業策略轉向

在實測體驗方面，DSH 的「軌跡(Trajectory)」功能獲得高度評價，該設計能全程記錄系統提示詞、思維鏈及工具呼叫過程，實現資料的「全程留痕」。在成本控制上，實測顯示重構網頁與呼叫 API 等任務的 Token 消耗不到 3 元人民幣，展現其經濟性。
分析指出，DeepSeek 此舉旨在效仿 Android 的開放路線，將競爭核心從單純銷售 Token 轉向建構 Agent 生態系。隨著 V4 系列模型上線，DeepSeek 也宣布將自 8 月 17 日起實施峰谷定價策略，透過閒時折價引導資源分配。
這套被視為「Agent OS」雛形的框架，正試圖透過開放「殼」的權限，吸引全球開發者共同定義下一代 AI 生產力標準。
paras_en: DeepSeek officially released its first AI agent development framework, DeepSeek Harness (DSH), on August 13, along with the DeepSeek-V4-Pro model for agent performance optimization. The project is open-source under the MIT license and has gained over 50,000 GitHub stars in just 12 hours, demonstrating the developer community's high interest.

The core design philosophy of DSH is 'everything is a plugin.' The framework is built on the Cordis plugin system, modularizing models, tools, sandboxes, user interfaces (UI), and even the agent's main loop.
DeepSeek compares the model to a 'brain' and Harness to 'hands,' emphasizing that an agent's value lies in delivering completed tasks, not just text-based conversations.

Project lead Cui Tianyi noted that the current 0.1.0 version is a developer preview and is still in its early stages, with the interface and plugin ecosystem rapidly evolving. He likened DSH to a 'super Lego car,' with the official Coding Agent being a default configuration that developers can freely replace with different engines, tires, or add modules, even creating entirely new forms.

The potential and controversy of 'self-evolving software' were also discussed. A 88-page technical paper was released alongside DSH, proposing the 'spatiotemporal composability' paradigm to allow agents to generate and replace components without human intervention. Early testers Jiayuan (JY) Zhang believe that DSH has the beginnings of 'self-evolving software,' with agents able to write and load plugins on the fly to gain new abilities.

However, this feature has sparked industry debate. Developer Bao Yu (@dotey) expressed reservations, suggesting that 'software self-evolution' might be a false narrative, as software requires rigorous design and verification, and over-automation could lead to chaos. He also pointed out that DSH's current entry barrier is high, requiring Node.js toolchains, making it less friendly to non-engineers.

The 'trajectory' feature of DSH has received high praise for its ability to record system prompts, thought chains, and tool calls throughout the process, achieving 'end-to-end logging.' In terms of cost control, testing showed that reconstructing web pages and calling APIs consumed less than 3 yuan in tokens, demonstrating its economic efficiency.

Analysis suggests that DeepSeek's move is aimed at emulating Android's open path, shifting the competitive core from simple token sales to building an agent ecosystem. With the V4 series model online, DeepSeek has announced that it will implement a peak-valley pricing strategy starting August 17, guiding resource allocation through idle-time discounts.

This framework, seen as a 'Agent OS' prototype, is attempting to attract global developers to collectively define the next-generation AI productivity standard by opening up the 'shell' permission. items.title: 原本不被看好成大作！寶可夢新遊戲狂賣500萬套 任天堂股價噴7%
paras: 任天堂(Nintendo)股價周五(14日)在東京收漲7%，主因Switch 2獨占遊戲《寶可夢 Pokopia》全球銷量突破500萬套，亮眼表現提振市場對遊戲軟體與主機銷售前景的信心。
任天堂周四宣布，《寶可夢 Pokopia》自3月5日上市以來，僅約4個月銷量便跨越500萬套，成為Switch 2目前銷量第二高的遊戲，超越《咚奇剛 蕉力全開》，僅次於《瑪利歐賽車世界》。
《寶可夢 Pokopia》並非寶可夢系列正統續作，上市前也未被視為重量級大作。遊戲融合寶可夢角色與世界觀，並加入類似《集合啦！動物森友會》的溫馨生活模擬玩法，市場反應超乎預期。任天堂也同步宣布將推出擴充內容與更新，以吸引新玩家並維持既有玩家的參與度。
由於該作是Switch 2獨占遊戲，分析師認為，軟體熱銷有望進一步帶動主機需求。東洋證券分析師安田秀樹表示，遊戲人氣可望支撐Switch 2銷售，加上《路透》報導任天堂計劃今年在印尼推出Switch系列主機，也將有助於推進全球市場布局。
任天堂股價周五一度大漲7.5%至8,945日圓，並有望連續第三周走高，創去年11月以來最長周線連漲紀錄。Aizawa Securities基金經理三井郁男指出，考量主要遊戲作品銷售表現穩健，任天堂股價突破1萬日圓並不令人意外。
任天堂今年一度受到記憶體價格上漲、Switch 2調漲售價及硬體銷量下滑等疑慮拖累。今年6月止季度，Switch 2銷量為382萬台，年減34.4%；公司預估截至2027年3月底的會計年度將售出1,650萬台，同樣低於前一年度。
不過，任天堂首季財報優於預期，逐漸緩解投資人對成本壓力侵蝕獲利的擔憂。該股過去一個月已反彈逾26%，儘管今年迄今仍下跌逾16%，分析師認為，隨市場疑慮降溫，加上《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》重製版及兩款寶可夢新作陸續推出，股價與主機銷售均有望迎來進一步復甦。

items.title: 13家金控前7月狂賺4927億元 國泰金奪單月獲利王、富邦金穩居累計獲利雙冠王
paras: 13家上市金控2026年7月自結獲利全數出爐！受7月全球金融市場波動加劇、美台股市震盪拉回影響，壽險與證券子公司評價及投資收益遭遇亂流，致使13家金控單月稅後純益合計降至518.94億元，較6月下滑約29.39%，由國泰金控奪下單月獲利王。不過，今年前7月資本市場活絡、銀行核心業務放款與財管手續費維持強勁成長，13家金控前7月累計稅後純益達4,927.82億元，較去年同期大幅成長124.78%，續創歷年同期新高，富邦金控仍為累計獲利王。
從金控 7 月獲利表現來看，國泰金是唯一突破百億的金控，達 108.2 億元，台新新光金以 89.4 億元居次，第三名為元大金 63.59 億元。而富邦金(2881-TW)7月自結稅後淨損17.6億元，主因7月國際科技股評價修正與台股單月下跌6.5%，致富邦人壽金融資產部位產生未實現評價損失，單月稅後淨損76.6億元。
累計前7月獲利部分，富邦金合併稅後純益達955.8億元，年增53.25%，EPS 6.54元，雙雙穩居金控獲利王寶座。國泰金合併稅後純益達873.4億元，年增59.47%，EPS 5.68元，位居第二名。第三名為台新新光金 527.8 億元，較去年同期暴增 281.36%，EPS  2.04 元，創下歷史新高。
累計獲利年增率方面，台新新光金合併效應逐漸顯現，前7月獲利暴增281.36%奪冠；國票金與凱基金年增率分別達204.82%及187.33%，分列二、三名；而元大金獲利年增 1.2 倍亦相當亮眼。
提醒投資人，壽險業於今年正式接軌 IFRS 17，FVOCI股票處分損益不計入當期損益，直接反映於保留盈餘，屬可分配盈餘來源之一。若加計FVOCI權益工具稅後處分利益，富邦金前7月累計達1,962.5億元，超越歷年全年獲利表現；國泰金累計前7月對保留盈餘影響數高達1,870億元，續創歷史新高。
加權指數 7 月下跌 6.5%，使得以證券為主體的元大金受到影響，雖元大證券獲利降至 48 億元，但元大銀行與元大期貨單月逆勢成長，帶動單月稅後純益仍有 63 億元的水準。凱基證券雖自營操作及投資評價表現受影響，但經紀暨財富管理以及期貨衍生性商品等業務表現相對平穩，單月獲利 7.21 億元，金控單月獲利僅 20.89億元。
永豐金 7 月表現穩健，雖銀行提存費用較高，但證券受惠於股利收入進補及所得稅費用降低，有效抵銷手續費受市場波動的影響，帶動金控單月稅後純益 43.81 億元，月增 3%，前 7 月累計稅後純益 289.32 億元，年增 89%，累計每股純益 (EPS) 達 1.96 元。
四家公股金控方面，單月獲利均呈月成長趨勢，兆豐金前7月稅後純益256.59億元，年增14.34%，EPS 1.73元，續創歷年同期新高；第一金累計前7月稅後純益209.37億元，年增23.60%，EPS 1.46元；華南金累計前7月稅後純益206.52億元，年增37.54%，EPS 1.48元，同創歷史同期新高；合庫金前7月稅後純益160.77億元，年增29.84%，EPS 0.99元。

items.title: 〈台灣大法說〉成長動能多軌並進 上修全年營業利益成長7至9%
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile's Investor Day: Multi‑Track Growth Momentum, Raises Full‑Year Operating Profit Growth to 7‑9%
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(14)日召開法說會，總經理林之晨指出，台灣大成長動能多軌並進，核心電信事業與momo業務穩健成長，企業電信事業及新科技事業也加速擴張，在不含精誠資訊(6214-TW)收購案影響下，上修營業利益成長7至9%。
根據台灣大1月公布的業績展望，預估合併營收成長5至7%，其中，電信業務與其他業務皆成長5至7%；合併營業利益成長1至2%，其中，電信營業利益成長4至6%，合併營益率約9至11%。
台灣大指出，在不含精誠資訊購案影響下，上修全年獲利展望，合併營業利益成長上修至7至9%，其中，電信業務營業利益則上調為13至15%，合併營益率上調至10至12%。另外，合併營收則維持先前看法。
林之晨提到，除Telco電信本業、Telco+企業電信事業，以及Telco+Tech科技電信事業三大成長引擎持續加速，台灣大也搶占AI代理時代的Alpha先機，提供企業級AIDC與AICT解決方案。
台灣大第二季營收 494.3 億元，季減 0.7%，年增 4.15%；EBITDA 114.97 億元，季增 1.26%，年增 8.56%；稅後純益 45.5 億元，季增 9.64%，年增 38.72%，創近20年新高，每股純益 1.49 元。
台灣大累計今年前 6 月營收 992.1 億元，年增 3.74%；EBITDA 228.51 億元，年增 8.07%；稅後純益 86.9 億元，年增 25.22%，每股純益 2.86 元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held its investor day today (the 14th). General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company’s growth momentum is advancing on multiple tracks: the core telecom business and the momo e‑commerce unit are growing steadily, while the enterprise telecom and new technology segments are expanding faster. Excluding the impact of the acquisition of Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW), the company has raised its operating‑profit growth outlook to 7‑9%.

According to the outlook released in January, Taiwan Mobile forecasts consolidated revenue to grow 5‑7%, with both telecom and other businesses each contributing 5‑7% growth. Consolidated operating profit is expected to rise 1‑2%, with telecom operating profit increasing 4‑6%, and the overall operating margin projected at roughly 9‑11%.

Taiwan Mobile noted that, without the effect of the Jingcheng Information acquisition, it is upgrading its full‑year profit outlook: consolidated operating profit growth is now expected at 7‑9%, and telecom operating profit is lifted to 13‑15%. The consolidated operating margin is revised up to 10‑12%. The consolidated revenue outlook remains unchanged.

Lin Chih‑chen added that, beyond the three main growth engines – the core Telco business, Telco + Enterprise telecom, and Telco + Tech telecom – Taiwan Mobile is also seizing the early‑alpha opportunity of the AI‑agent era, offering enterprise‑grade AIDC and AICT solutions.

In the second quarter, Taiwan Mobile posted revenue of NT$49.43 billion, down 0.7% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 4.15% year‑over‑year; EBITDA was NT$11.497 billion, up 1.26% QoQ and 8.56% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$4.55 billion, up 9.64% QoQ and 38.72% YoY, a near‑20‑year high, with earnings per share of NT$1.49.

For the first six months of the year, Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue reached NT$99.21 billion, up 3.74% YoY; EBITDA was NT$22.851 billion, up 8.07% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$8.69 billion, up 25.22% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$2.86.

items.title: 技嘉Q2大賺近1個股本 年增逾1倍 上修資本支出至28-30億元
paras: PC品牌技嘉(2376-TW)今(14)日公佈第二季財報，第二季稅後純益66.1億元，年增逾一倍，每股純益9.86元；累計上半年稅後純益118.7億元，年增 92.6 %，每股純益 17.73 元；技嘉表示，看好客戶下半年需求持續強勁，已上修資本支出至28至30億元。
技嘉第二季營收 1442.1 億元，季增 37.3 %，年增 41.0 %；毛利率 9.6 %，季減 2.4 個百分點，年增 0.2 個百分點；營業利益 81.2億 元，季增 9.5 %，年增 53.4 %；營益率 5.6 %，季減 1.4 個百分點，年增 0.5 個百分點。稅後純益 66.1 億元，季增 25.4 %，年增 116.6 %，每股純益 9.86 元。
技嘉上半年累計營收 2492.7 億元，年增 48.4 %；毛利率 10.6 %，年減 0.2 個百分點；營業利益 155.3億元，年增 63.0 %；營益率 6.2 %，年增 0.6 個百分點；稅後純益 118.7 億元，年增 92.6 %，每股純益 17.73 元。
技嘉將全年資本支出從23-25億元區間，上修至28-30億元；展望下半年，技嘉看好AI客戶算力需求強烈，也帶動訂單能見度提高，隨著基礎設施進度及關鍵零組件配改善，出貨可望更加順暢。
技嘉表示，為因應營運擴張及海外採購料件所需資金，技嘉董事會決議辦理現金增資發行普通股40000仟股至50000仟股以參與發行海外存託憑證，每股面額新台幣10元，增資資金用途全數鎖定外幣購料。

items.title_en: Foreign Capital Buys NT$206.1 Billion in a Week, Favoring Powerchip
paras: 台股今(14)日開高走低，下跌210點作收，終場收45,811點，成交金額略微放大至1.06兆元。外資單日買超453億元，累計本周 5個交易連續買超5日買超達2,061億元，其中看好記憶體回溫、代工價格調漲，單日加碼力積電(6770-TW) 14.49萬張居完 ，連 4買超共31.63萬張。
三大法人操作部分，外資單日買超453.51億元、投信買超71.96億元、自營商賣超16.61億元，三大法人合計共買超508.86億元。期貨部位，外資期貨空單減少1,034口，累計為8.51萬口。

今日外資單日買超前10名中，外資買超力積電14.49萬張居冠，其次買進主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)9.52萬張、主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)5.86萬張、華邦電5.58萬張、仁寶4.78萬張、群創3.96萬張、元大台灣50(0050-TW)3.58萬張、主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)2.77萬張、主動凱基台灣(00407A)2.7萬張、寶成2.11萬張。外資今日也調節台積電由連5買轉賣3,024張。
外資單日賣超前10名中，賣超國巨*2.22萬張居冠、其次賣超中鋼1.89萬張，也大賣金融股玉山金1.73萬張、臺企銀1.64萬張、華航1.63萬張、長榮航1.61萬張、國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)1.48萬張、元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)1.12萬張、南亞科1萬張、元大金9,277張。
投信單日買超前10名中共9名皆為金融股，台新新光金、凱基金同為2.5萬張最多、玉山金1.83萬張、兆豐金1.55萬張、第一金1.46萬張、永豐金1.44萬張、華南金1.16萬張、元大金5,100張、華邦電3,770張、富邦特選高股息30(00900-TW)2,500張。
投信單日賣超前10名，則以電子權值股為主，大賣聯電5,627張、大成鋼5,000    張、日月光投控3,770張、緯創2,862張、鴻海2,552張、昇陽半導體1,544    張、南亞1,491張，賣景碩、勤誠、華通。
法人表示，台股今日呈現開高走低格局，指數正挑戰前波歷史高點壓力區，技術面上今日台股漲多拉回整理，目前在台股波動率走低態勢不變下，續作高檔整理，短線台股的拉回仍可以樂觀看待。籌碼布局上觀察，外資期現貨樂觀布局，整體籌碼面略為樂觀。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market opened high and closed low today, with the index falling 210 points to 45,811. The trading volume increased slightly to NT$1.06 trillion. Foreign investors bought a net NT$45.35 billion, making it the fifth consecutive day of net buying, with a total of NT$206.1 billion for the week. They were optimistic about the memory chip industry's rebound and the increase in foundry prices, and bought 144,900 shares of Powerchip (6770-TW) on the day, with a total of 316,300 shares over four days.

In terms of the operations of the three major institutional investors, foreign investors bought a net NT$45.35 billion, while investment trusts bought a net NT$7.2 billion, and dealers sold a net NT$1.66 billion. The total net buying of the three major institutional investors was NT$50.89 billion. In the futures market, foreign investors reduced their short positions by 1,034 contracts, with a total of 85,100 contracts.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net buying by foreign investors, Powerchip ranked first with 144,900 shares, followed by Fubon TWSE Taiwan 50 (00981A-TW) with 95,200 shares, Fubon Taiwan 50 (00403A-TW) with 58,600 shares, and other stocks. Foreign investors also adjusted their holdings of TSMC, selling 3,024 shares.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net selling by foreign investors, China Steel ranked first with 22,200 shares, followed by other stocks such as Yuanta Financial and EVA Airways. Foreign investors also sold a significant number of shares in the financial sector.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net buying by investment trusts, all were in the financial sector, with Taiwan Shin Kong Financial and Cathay Financial both buying 25,000 shares, followed by other stocks such as Yuanta Financial and Mega Financial.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net selling by investment trusts, most were in the electronics sector, with United Microelectronics selling 5,627 shares, followed by other stocks such as AU Optronics and Pegatron.

Institutional investors said that the Taiwan stock market presented a pattern of opening high and closing low today, with the index challenging the historical high point pressure zone. From a technical perspective, the market is still in a state of low volatility, and the current high-level adjustment is expected to continue. The layout of the chips is still optimistic, and the overall chip layout is slightly optimistic.

items.title: 一卡通跨域結盟再升級 攜手WeMo、精誠資訊擴大生態系
items.title_en: iPASS Expands Cross‑Domain Alliances, Partners with WeMo and iCHEM to Grow Ecosystem
paras: 數位支付逐漸融入日常生活，民眾對於「一站式」數位服務的需求日益提升。一卡通公司持續深化 iPASS MONEY 數位支付服務，積極透過「iPASS Connect+」計畫拓展跨產業合作，今(14)日宣布攜手共享機車品牌 WeMo 及精誠資訊，將移動服務、數位票券導入 iPASS MONEY APP；同時優化生活服務功能，領先同業推出「二代社福卡靠卡查詢社福點數」等服務，讓 iPASS MONEY 逐步成為串聯民眾日常生活的數位服務平台。
一卡通董事長郭添貴表示，未來將持續以「生活場景」為核心，透過跨產業夥伴合作及 APP 服務優化，串聯交通、移動、消費、優惠與公共服務等多元應用，為超過 725 萬用戶持續擴大 iPASS MONEY 生態系的廣度與深度。
為讓支付服務更貼近民眾實際生活場景，iPASS MONEY APP「商家地圖」功能正式升級，新增 WeMo 共享機車搜尋服務。用戶開啟 APP 進入「商家地圖」，即可查看附近 WeMo 共享機車停放地點與車號，找到車輛後即可前往借車與付款，實現從「找車」到「付款」的一站式體驗。
一卡通亦宣布與精誠資訊合作，於 iPASS MONEY APP 首頁建置「好禮券」專區，整合吃喝玩樂與生活消費等數位票券需求。精誠資訊表示，此次合作結合了金流、點數與電子券，並以無紙化數位票券取代傳統紙本，結合一卡通綠點回饋機制，讓數位消費成為日常減碳行動的一環。
在公共服務領域，一卡通積極響應地方政府社會福利政策，APP 領先同業推出「一卡通 PLUS 二代社福卡」靠卡查詢功能。持卡人只需將卡片貼近手機的「票卡感應機」，即可即時確認社福點數餘額、錢包金額與近期扣點明細，大幅降低民眾因點數不足而影響搭乘大眾運輸的困擾。此外，各式社福卡亦可透過卡號綁定 APP 隨時掌握扣點狀況。
為慶祝新服務上線，一卡通即日起至12月31日推出多重優惠：使用APP搜尋並綁定iPASS MONEY騎乘WeMo任一筆，即贈50元騎乘券；首頁「好禮券」專區開放全台逾2.5萬家門市使用，連結消費可享最高10%綠點回饋(每人每月最高200點)，綠點1點折抵1元；此外，四大超商更擴大支援指定信用卡與Debit卡付款，享多元支付便利與優惠。
paras_en: Digital payments are gradually becoming part of everyday life, and the public’s demand for a "one‑stop" digital service is rising. iPASS Co. continues to deepen its iPASS MONEY digital payment service and actively expands cross‑industry cooperation through the "iPASS Connect+" program. On the 14th, it announced partnerships with shared‑scooter brand WeMo and iCHEM Information, bringing mobility services and digital tickets into the iPASS MONEY app. At the same time, it is enhancing lifestyle‑service functions, leading the industry with services such as the "Second‑Generation Social Welfare Card – Card‑Based Query of Welfare Points," positioning iPASS MONEY to become a digital platform that links citizens’ daily lives.

iPASS Chairman Guo Tiangui said the company will keep "life scenarios" at its core, using cross‑industry partner collaborations and app service optimizations to connect transportation, mobility, consumption, discounts and public services. This will continuously expand the breadth and depth of the iPASS MONEY ecosystem for its more than 7.25 million users.

To bring payment services closer to real‑life scenarios, the iPASS MONEY app’s "Merchant Map" feature has been upgraded to include a WeMo shared‑scooter search service. Users opening the app and entering the "Merchant Map" can view nearby WeMo scooter parking spots and vehicle numbers; once a scooter is located, they can proceed to rent and pay, achieving a one‑stop experience from "finding a scooter" to "payment."

iPASS also announced a partnership with iCHEM Information to create a "Good Voucher" section on the iPASS MONEY app homepage, consolidating digital tickets for dining, entertainment and everyday consumption. iCHEM said the collaboration integrates payment flow, points and e‑vouchers, replacing traditional paper tickets with paper‑less digital vouchers and linking them to iPASS’s green‑point reward mechanism, making digital consumption part of daily carbon‑reduction actions.

In the public‑service arena, iPASS is actively responding to local government social‑welfare policies, launching an industry‑leading "iPASS PLUS Second‑Generation Social Welfare Card" card‑based query function. Cardholders simply tap their card near the phone’s "ticket‑card sensor" to instantly check welfare‑point balances, wallet amount and recent deduction details, greatly reducing the inconvenience of insufficient points affecting public‑transport rides. Additionally, various welfare cards can be bound to the app by card number to monitor deduction status at any time.

To celebrate the new services, iPASS is offering multiple promotions from now until December 31: any ride on WeMo booked and linked through the app earns a NT$50 ride voucher; the homepage "Good Voucher" section opens to over 25,000 stores nationwide, with linked purchases eligible for up to 10% green‑point rebates (capped at 200 points per person per month), where 1 green point equals NT$1; moreover, the four major convenience‑store chains are expanding support for designated credit and debit cards, providing more payment convenience and discounts.

items.title: 台灣家庭所得差距達6.17倍 創14年新高
items.title_en: Taiwan Household Income Gap Reaches 6.17 Times, Sets 14-Year High
paras: 主計總處今(14)日公布114年家庭收支調查結果，114年可支配所得最高20%家庭平均每戶244.9萬元，年增3.9%，最低20%家庭平均每戶39.7萬元，年增3.5%，差距達6.17倍創14年來新高。
而在納計政府對家庭移轉收支(社福及租稅)前，114年每戶五等分位所得差距倍數7.49倍，年增0.11倍。
主計總處表示，由於各級政府對家庭提供各項補助，包括低收入戶生活補助、中低收入老人生活津貼、老農津貼、育兒津貼、各項社會保險保費補助等，縮小所得差距1.18倍，另家庭對政府移轉支出也縮小所得差距0.15倍。
主計總處統計，114年全體家庭平均每戶所得總額152.9萬元，年增3.3%，每戶可支配所得平均數121.0萬元，年增3.9%，每人平均數45.0萬元，增7.4%。
若以中位數衡量，114年每戶可支配所得中位數為101.8萬元，年增3.4%，每人中位數為36.7萬元，增3.2%。
而114年全體家庭平均每戶消費支出92.0萬元，年增3.6%，平均每戶儲蓄29.0萬元，年增4.9%。
就消費支出內容觀察，以住宅服務、水電瓦斯和其他燃料占24.1%為最高，其次為食品飲料及菸草占15.4%，另隨著國人平均壽命延長，衛生保健觀念增強，醫療保健支出占14.1%。
paras_en: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics announced today (14th) the results of the 2023 household income and expenditure survey. The top 20% of households with the highest disposable income averaged NT$2,449,000, a 3.9% increase from last year. The bottom 20% of households averaged NT$397,000, a 3.5% increase from last year, with a gap of 6.17 times, a 14-year high.

Before accounting for government transfers to households (social welfare and taxes), the income gap between the top 20% and the bottom 20% of households was 7.49 times in 2023, a 0.11 times increase from last year.

The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics stated that due to various government subsidies provided to households, including low-income household living subsidies, middle- and low-income elderly living allowances, old farmer subsidies, childcare subsidies, and various social insurance premium subsidies, the income gap was narrowed by 1.18 times. Additionally, household government transfers also narrowed the income gap by 0.15 times.

According to the statistics, the average household income in 2023 was NT$1,529,000, a 3.3% increase from last year. The average disposable income per household was NT$1,210,000, a 3.9% increase from last year. The average income per person was NT$450,000, a 7.4% increase from last year.

Using the median to measure, the average disposable income per household in 2023 was NT$1,018,000, a 3.4% increase from last year. The average income per person was NT$367,000, a 3.2% increase from last year.
The average household expenditure in 2023 was NT$920,000, a 3.6% increase from last year. The average household savings was NT$290,000, a 4.9% increase from last year.

Looking at the composition of household expenditure, the highest was residential services, water, gas, and other fuels at 24.1%, followed by food, beverages, and tobacco at 15.4%. With the average lifespan of the Taiwanese people increasing and health awareness improving, medical and health care expenditure accounted for 14.1%.

items.title: 13家金控前7月狂賺4927億元 國泰金奪單月獲利王、富邦金穩居累計獲利雙冠王
paras: 13家上市金控2026年7月自結獲利全數出爐！受7月全球金融市場波動加劇、美台股市震盪拉回影響，壽險與證券子公司評價及投資收益遭遇亂流，致使13家金控單月稅後純益合計降至518.94億元，較6月下滑約29.39%，由國泰金控奪下單月獲利王。不過，今年前7月資本市場活絡、銀行核心業務放款與財管手續費維持強勁成長，13家金控前7月累計稅後純益達4,927.82億元，較去年同期大幅成長124.78%，續創歷年同期新高，富邦金控仍為累計獲利王。
從金控 7 月獲利表現來看，國泰金是唯一突破百億的金控，達 108.2 億元，台新新光金以 89.4 億元居次，第三名為元大金 63.59 億元。而富邦金(2881-TW)7月自結稅後淨損17.6億元，主因7月國際科技股評價修正與台股單月下跌6.5%，致富邦人壽金融資產部位產生未實現評價損失，單月稅後淨損76.6億元。
累計前7月獲利部分，富邦金合併稅後純益達955.8億元，年增53.25%，EPS 6.54元，雙雙穩居金控獲利王寶座。國泰金合併稅後純益達873.4億元，年增59.47%，EPS 5.68元，位居第二名。第三名為台新新光金 527.8 億元，較去年同期暴增 281.36%，EPS  2.04 元，創下歷史新高。
累計獲利年增率方面，台新新光金合併效應逐漸顯現，前7月獲利暴增281.36%奪冠；國票金與凱基金年增率分別達204.82%及187.33%，分列二、三名；而元大金獲利年增 1.2 倍亦相當亮眼。
提醒投資人，壽險業於今年正式接軌 IFRS 17，FVOCI股票處分損益不計入當期損益，直接反映於保留盈餘，屬可分配盈餘來源之一。若加計FVOCI權益工具稅後處分利益，富邦金前7月累計達1,962.5億元，超越歷年全年獲利表現；國泰金累計前7月對保留盈餘影響數高達1,870億元，續創歷史新高。
加權指數 7 月下跌 6.5%，使得以證券為主體的元大金受到影響，雖元大證券獲利降至 48 億元，但元大銀行與元大期貨單月逆勢成長，帶動單月稅後純益仍有 63 億元的水準。凱基證券雖自營操作及投資評價表現受影響，但經紀暨財富管理以及期貨衍生性商品等業務表現相對平穩，單月獲利 7.21 億元，金控單月獲利僅 20.89億元。
永豐金 7 月表現穩健，雖銀行提存費用較高，但證券受惠於股利收入進補及所得稅費用降低，有效抵銷手續費受市場波動的影響，帶動金控單月稅後純益 43.81 億元，月增 3%，前 7 月累計稅後純益 289.32 億元，年增 89%，累計每股純益 (EPS) 達 1.96 元。
四家公股金控方面，單月獲利均呈月成長趨勢，兆豐金前7月稅後純益256.59億元，年增14.34%，EPS 1.73元，續創歷年同期新高；第一金累計前7月稅後純益209.37億元，年增23.60%，EPS 1.46元；華南金累計前7月稅後純益206.52億元，年增37.54%，EPS 1.48元，同創歷史同期新高；合庫金前7月稅後純益160.77億元，年增29.84%，EPS 0.99元。

items.title: 〈台灣大法說〉成長動能多軌並進 上修全年營業利益成長7至9%
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile's Investor Day: Multi‑Track Growth Momentum, Raises Full‑Year Operating Profit Growth to 7‑9%
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(14)日召開法說會，總經理林之晨指出，台灣大成長動能多軌並進，核心電信事業與momo業務穩健成長，企業電信事業及新科技事業也加速擴張，在不含精誠資訊(6214-TW)收購案影響下，上修營業利益成長7至9%。
根據台灣大1月公布的業績展望，預估合併營收成長5至7%，其中，電信業務與其他業務皆成長5至7%；合併營業利益成長1至2%，其中，電信營業利益成長4至6%，合併營益率約9至11%。
台灣大指出，在不含精誠資訊購案影響下，上修全年獲利展望，合併營業利益成長上修至7至9%，其中，電信業務營業利益則上調為13至15%，合併營益率上調至10至12%。另外，合併營收則維持先前看法。
林之晨提到，除Telco電信本業、Telco+企業電信事業，以及Telco+Tech科技電信事業三大成長引擎持續加速，台灣大也搶占AI代理時代的Alpha先機，提供企業級AIDC與AICT解決方案。
台灣大第二季營收 494.3 億元，季減 0.7%，年增 4.15%；EBITDA 114.97 億元，季增 1.26%，年增 8.56%；稅後純益 45.5 億元，季增 9.64%，年增 38.72%，創近20年新高，每股純益 1.49 元。
台灣大累計今年前 6 月營收 992.1 億元，年增 3.74%；EBITDA 228.51 億元，年增 8.07%；稅後純益 86.9 億元，年增 25.22%，每股純益 2.86 元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held its investor day today (the 14th). General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company’s growth momentum is advancing on multiple tracks: the core telecom business and the momo e‑commerce unit are growing steadily, while the enterprise telecom and new technology segments are expanding faster. Excluding the impact of the acquisition of Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW), the company has raised its operating‑profit growth outlook to 7‑9%.

According to the outlook released in January, Taiwan Mobile forecasts consolidated revenue to grow 5‑7%, with both telecom and other businesses each contributing 5‑7% growth. Consolidated operating profit is expected to rise 1‑2%, with telecom operating profit increasing 4‑6%, and the overall operating margin projected at roughly 9‑11%.

Taiwan Mobile noted that, without the effect of the Jingcheng Information acquisition, it is upgrading its full‑year profit outlook: consolidated operating profit growth is now expected at 7‑9%, and telecom operating profit is lifted to 13‑15%. The consolidated operating margin is revised up to 10‑12%. The consolidated revenue outlook remains unchanged.

Lin Chih‑chen added that, beyond the three main growth engines – the core Telco business, Telco + Enterprise telecom, and Telco + Tech telecom – Taiwan Mobile is also seizing the early‑alpha opportunity of the AI‑agent era, offering enterprise‑grade AIDC and AICT solutions.

In the second quarter, Taiwan Mobile posted revenue of NT$49.43 billion, down 0.7% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 4.15% year‑over‑year; EBITDA was NT$11.497 billion, up 1.26% QoQ and 8.56% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$4.55 billion, up 9.64% QoQ and 38.72% YoY, a near‑20‑year high, with earnings per share of NT$1.49.

For the first six months of the year, Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue reached NT$99.21 billion, up 3.74% YoY; EBITDA was NT$22.851 billion, up 8.07% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$8.69 billion, up 25.22% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$2.86.

items.title: 技嘉Q2大賺近1個股本 年增逾1倍 上修資本支出至28-30億元
paras: PC品牌技嘉(2376-TW)今(14)日公佈第二季財報，第二季稅後純益66.1億元，年增逾一倍，每股純益9.86元；累計上半年稅後純益118.7億元，年增 92.6 %，每股純益 17.73 元；技嘉表示，看好客戶下半年需求持續強勁，已上修資本支出至28至30億元。
技嘉第二季營收 1442.1 億元，季增 37.3 %，年增 41.0 %；毛利率 9.6 %，季減 2.4 個百分點，年增 0.2 個百分點；營業利益 81.2億 元，季增 9.5 %，年增 53.4 %；營益率 5.6 %，季減 1.4 個百分點，年增 0.5 個百分點。稅後純益 66.1 億元，季增 25.4 %，年增 116.6 %，每股純益 9.86 元。
技嘉上半年累計營收 2492.7 億元，年增 48.4 %；毛利率 10.6 %，年減 0.2 個百分點；營業利益 155.3億元，年增 63.0 %；營益率 6.2 %，年增 0.6 個百分點；稅後純益 118.7 億元，年增 92.6 %，每股純益 17.73 元。
技嘉將全年資本支出從23-25億元區間，上修至28-30億元；展望下半年，技嘉看好AI客戶算力需求強烈，也帶動訂單能見度提高，隨著基礎設施進度及關鍵零組件配改善，出貨可望更加順暢。
技嘉表示，為因應營運擴張及海外採購料件所需資金，技嘉董事會決議辦理現金增資發行普通股40000仟股至50000仟股以參與發行海外存託憑證，每股面額新台幣10元，增資資金用途全數鎖定外幣購料。

items.title: 公股金控獲利飆速！第一金前7月站上200億里程碑 合庫金年增3成續創同期高
items.title_en: State-owned Financial Holding Companies Post Rapid Profits! First Financial Holding Co. Surpasses NT$20 Billion in First 7 Months, and Hua Nan Financial Holding Co. Posts 33.2% Year-on-Year Growth
paras: 公股金控前七月獲利版圖揭曉，繼兆豐金、華南金之後，第一金控（2892-TW）合庫金（5880-TW）同步於今（14）日公布最新自結獲利，受惠銀行，證券及壽險子公司同步挹注，第一金累計前7月稅後純益達209.37億元、年增23.6%，每股稅後純益（EPS）1.46元，改寫歷年同期新高，也正式躋身「200億元俱樂部」。合庫金不遑多讓，前7月合併稅後純益160.77億元，年增幅高達33.2%，續創歷年同期新高，旗下銀行、證券及壽險前7月獲利也同步改寫同期新高紀錄，繳出亮麗成績單。
第一金7月單月稅後純益31.39億元，較6月成長4.7%，年增4.84%。其中，核心獲利引擎第一銀行表現亮眼，受惠股利收入進帳，帶動金融交易收益大幅成長，推升7月單月稅後純益衝上32.02億元，不僅月增27.1%，更較去年同期成長16.23%，創下歷史單月新高紀錄。
第一銀行指出，除了股利收入貢獻外，淨利息收入及淨手續費收入仍維持穩健成長動能，資產品質亦持續維持高檔水準。截至7月底止，逾放比維持在0.16%，覆蓋率則進一步提升至876.8%。累計前7月稅後純益達186.58億元，較去年同期成長12.7%。
除了銀行本業穩健成長外，第一金旗下證券事業今年更成為獲利黑馬。第一金證券7月稅後純益1.21億元，受到台股回檔影響，經紀手續費收入與投資收益同步下滑，單月獲利月減58.4%、年減2.42%。不過，在上半年股市交投熱絡帶動下，累計前7月稅後純益仍達15.31億元，較去年同期大增262.9%，不僅提前超越去年全年獲利，更刷新歷史紀錄。
壽險子公司方面，第一金人壽受惠投資收益增加，7月稅後淨利1.75億元，較上月大增160.6%，年增44.63%；累計前7月稅後淨利則達5.93億元，持續為集團貢獻獲利動能。
另一方面，同屬公股金控的合庫金亦交出亮眼成績單。合庫金7月單月合併稅後純益26.77億元，累計前7月合併稅後淨利達160.77億元，較去年同期增加40.07億元，年增幅高達33.2%，續創歷年同期新高。
觀察合庫金旗下主要子公司表現，銀行、證券及壽險三大事業前7月獲利全數改寫同期新高紀錄。其中，核心子公司合庫銀行累計稅後淨利142.55億元，年增12.55%，穩居主要獲利來源。
值得注意的是，合庫證券今年獲利成長幅度最為驚人，累計前7月稅後淨利達13.61億元，較去年同期大增13.33億元，幾乎呈現倍數成長。合庫人壽則受惠投資及保險業務表現改善，累計稅後淨利11.28億元，較去年同期增加9.19億元，年增約4.4倍，展現強勁獲利爆發力。
paras_en: State-owned financial holding companies First Financial Holding Co. (2892-TW) and Hua Nan Financial Holding Co. (5880-TW) simultaneously announced their latest quarterly earnings on August 14, benefiting from their banking, securities, and life insurance subsidiaries. First Financial Holding Co. reported a net profit of NT$20.937 billion for the first seven months of the year, up 23.6% year-on-year, with an earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.46, setting a new high for the same period. Hua Nan Financial Holding Co. also reported a net profit of NT$16.077 billion for the first seven months, up 33.2% year-on-year, setting a new high for the same period.

First Financial Holding Co. reported a single-month net profit of NT$1.339 billion in July, up 4.7% from June and 4.84% year-on-year. The company's core business, First Bank, performed well, with its net interest income and net commission income continuing to grow steadily. The bank's net profit for July reached NT$1.202 billion, up 27.1% from the previous month and 16.23% year-on-year, setting a new high for a single month.

First Bank attributed its strong performance to the increase in dividend income and net interest income, as well as the steady growth in net commission income. The bank's asset quality remained high, with a loan-to-deposit ratio of 0.16% and a coverage ratio of 876.8% as of the end of July. The bank's net profit for the first seven months reached NT$18.658 billion, up 12.7% year-on-year.

In addition to the steady growth in its banking business, First Financial Holding Co.'s securities business has become a surprise performer this year. First Financial Securities reported a net profit of NT$121 million in July, down 58.4% from the previous month and 2.42% year-on-year, due to the decline in brokerage fees and investment income. However, the company's net profit for the first seven months reached NT$1.531 billion, up 262.9% year-on-year, exceeding last year's full-year profit and setting a new record.

The company's life insurance subsidiary, First Life Insurance, benefited from the increase in investment income and reported a net profit of NT$175 million in July, up 160.6% from the previous month and 44.63% year-on-year. The company's net profit for the first seven months reached NT$593 million, continuing to contribute to the group's profitability.

Hua Nan Financial Holding Co. also reported a strong performance, with a single-month net profit of NT$2.677 billion in July and a net profit of NT$16.077 billion for the first seven months, up 40.07 billion year-on-year and 33.2% year-on-year, setting a new high for the same period.

Hua Nan Financial Holding Co.'s main subsidiaries, including Hua Nan Bank, Hua Nan Securities, and Hua Nan Life Insurance, all reported new highs for the same period. Hua Nan Bank's net profit for the first seven months reached NT$14.255 billion, up 12.55% year-on-year, remaining the main contributor to the group's profitability.

Notably, Hua Nan Securities reported a remarkable growth in profit, with a net profit of NT$1.361 billion for the first seven months, up NT$1.333 billion year-on-year, almost doubling. Hua Nan Life Insurance also benefited from the improvement in investment and insurance business, with a net profit of NT$1.128 billion for the first seven months, up NT$919 million year-on-year, and a year-on-year growth of approximately 4.4 times, showing strong profit growth.

items.title: 川普對無人機徵收100%關稅 料加深美中科技脫鉤
items.title_en: Trump Imposes 100% Tariff on Drones, Likely Deepening US-China Tech Decoupling
paras: 川普政府周四(13日)宣布，將對進口無人機及其零部件徵收最高達 100% 的關稅。此舉被視為美國減少對外國供應商依賴、保護本土產業的重大升級，並可能加速美中兩國在無人機供應鏈上的「脫鉤」進程。
根據白宮公告，這項關稅政策採取分級制：重量超過 25 公斤或具備特定性能的重型無人機將面臨 100% 的最高稅率；較小型的無人機則徵收 25% 的關稅。
為了鞏固與盟友的關係，美國對特定貿易夥伴提供了優惠：來自歐盟、日本、瑞士及台灣的無人機，若硬體與技術皆源自當地或美國，稅率將降至 15%，而英國則適用 10% 的稅率。多數關稅將在簽署後 21 天內生效，部分非敏感零部件則有 180 天的緩衝期。
此次決策是依據《1962年貿易擴張法》第 232 條，以國家安全為由發起調查後制定的。商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)指出，美國對外國無人機系統的依賴已達「實質性」程度，對國家安全構成風險。
川普在公告中強調，無人機系統對美國的國家與經濟安全至關重要。特別是俄烏戰爭充分展現了無人機在現代混合戰爭中的軍事效能，促使華府更具緊迫感地去扶持國內產業，避免在關鍵技術上受制於人。
雖然官方聲明未直接點名中國，但目標顯然直指全球最大的無人機製造國。在此之前，聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)已採取行動阻止大疆創新(DJI)等新機型進口，大疆去年曾占據美國 70% 的商用市場。專家分析，美中雙方正滑向特定類型無人機的「硬脫鉤」，這已成為兩國在基本貿易協定下持續進行低層級對抗的一部分。
受此政策激勵，美國本土無人機製造商如 AeroVironment 與 Aevex Corp 的股價在消息公布後大幅跳升。然而，中國方面也已展開反擊，對軍用無人機及關鍵技術實施「逐案審查」的出口管制。
paras_en: The Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 13th) that it will levy tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and their components. The move is seen as a major upgrade in the United States’ effort to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and protect domestic industry, and it could accelerate the “decoupling” of the US and China in the drone supply chain.

According to the White House announcement, the tariff policy uses a tiered system: heavy drones weighing more than 25 kilograms or possessing certain capabilities will face the maximum 100% rate, while smaller drones will be subject to a 25% tariff.

To strengthen ties with allies, the United States is offering preferential rates for specific trading partners: drones from the EU, Japan, Switzerland and Taiwan that are wholly sourced in hardware and technology from the local market or the United States will see the rate reduced to 15%, and the United Kingdom will receive a 10% rate. Most tariffs will take effect within 21 days of signing, with a 180‑day grace period for certain non‑sensitive components.

The decision is based on Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, invoked on national‑security grounds after an investigation. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said U.S. reliance on foreign drone systems has reached a “substantial” level that poses a risk to national security.

In the announcement, Trump stressed that drone systems are critical to America’s national and economic security. The Russia‑Ukraine war has highlighted the military effectiveness of drones in modern hybrid warfare, giving Washington a heightened sense of urgency to support domestic producers and avoid dependence on critical technology.

Although the official statement did not name China directly, the target is clearly the world’s largest drone manufacturer. Previously, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) moved to block new models from DJI and other firms; DJI accounted for about 70% of the U.S. commercial drone market last year. Experts say the U.S. and China are moving toward a “hard decoupling” of certain drone types, becoming part of a low‑level confrontation that persists despite broader trade agreements.

The policy spurred a sharp rise in the share prices of U.S. drone makers such as AeroVironment and Aevex Corp after the news broke. China, meanwhile, has begun retaliating with case‑by‑case export controls on military drones and key technologies.

items.title: 應用材料Q4展望優於預期仍跌5%市場憂成長落後同業
items.title_en: Applied Materials Q4 Outlook Better Than Expected, Still Drops 5% as Market Worries About Growth Lag
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 應用材料Applied Materials(AMAT-US)週五盤前股價下跌約5%，儘管公司公布優於市場預期的2026會計年度第4季財測，但在股價今年已上漲約1倍後，投資人對成長要求提高，加上半導體設備市場競爭加劇，亮眼財測仍未能消除市場疑慮。
應用材料預估會計年度第4季營收約102.5億美元，高於市場預估的95.4億美元，毛利率預估維持在50.4%。不過，市場更關注公司能否在晶圓廠設備市場取得高於同業的成長，尤其科林研發Lam Research(LRCX-US)與科磊KLA(KLAC-US)先前均繳出強勁業績，艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-US)也已上調2026年展望。
市場分析認為，應用材料近期營收成長速度落後部分主要競爭對手，使投資人即使面對優於預期的財測，仍對後續市占率與成長動能保持謹慎。
估值方面，應用材料預估本益比約32.14倍，低於Lam Research的34.59倍、KLA的36.85倍及ASML的33.39倍。半導體設備股估值普遍處於較高水準，也意味市場對成長放緩的容忍度降低，財測優於預期已不足以單獨推升股價。

paras_en: On August 14, 2026, Applied Materials (AMAT-US) saw its stock price drop by about 5% before the market opened, despite the company releasing a better-than-expected forecast for the fourth quarter of the 2026 fiscal year. This drop occurred after the stock had already risen by about 100% this year, with investors now having higher growth expectations, coupled with increased competition in the semiconductor equipment market, making the promising forecast insufficient to alleviate market concerns.

Applied Materials estimates its fourth-quarter revenue to be around $10.25 billion, higher than the market's estimate of $9.54 billion, with a gross margin rate expected to remain at 50.4%. However, the market is more focused on whether the company can achieve growth higher than its peers in the wafer fabrication equipment market, especially after Lam Research (LRCX-US) and KLA (KLAC-US) reported strong performances, and ASML (ASML-US) has already raised its 2026 outlook.

Market analysts believe that Applied Materials' recent revenue growth rate has lagged behind some of its major competitors, making investors cautious about the company's future market share and growth momentum, even when faced with better-than-expected forecasts.

In terms of valuation, Applied Materials' estimated price-to-earnings ratio is around 32.14 times, lower than Lam Research's 34.59 times, KLA's 36.85 times, and ASML's 33.39 times. The high valuation of semiconductor equipment stocks also means that the market has a lower tolerance for growth slowdowns, and a better-than-expected forecast is no longer enough to single-handedly boost the stock price.

items.title: 頂尖研究員余家輝宣布離開 Meta祭高薪挖角卻仍難留住人才
paras: Meta 超級智能實驗室(Meta Superintelligence Labs, MSL)核心成員、多模態研究負責人余家輝(Jiahui Yu)周五(14日)正式宣布離職，並計畫創辦新公司。
余家輝自 2025 年 6 月加入 Meta 以來，帶領團隊推出了 Muse 系列原生多模態模型，是 Meta 近年來在生成式人工智慧(Generative AI)領域的重要戰力。

從學霸到頂尖工程師

余家輝的學術與職業生涯始終環繞著「多模態」技術。他出身於中國科學技術大學少年班，隨後取得伊利諾大學厄巴納－香檳分校(UIUC)博士學位，師從知名電腦視覺學者黃煦濤。
在進入 Meta 之前，他已是 AI 界公認的頂尖人才，曾參與 Google 的 Gemini 專案，並擔任 OpenAI 感知(Perception)團隊負責人，主導 GPT-4o 及 o 系列推理模型的研發。
加入 Meta 後，余家輝擔任超級智能實驗室旗下 TBD Lab 的多模態技術負責人。他在離職公告中表示，過去一年在 Meta 與執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)及首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 共同建設 TBD Lab 的經歷
「極具啟發且充實」。

Muse 系列產品線完備

在余家輝任職的 14 個月內，TBD Lab 完成了密集的產品發布。從 2026 年 4 月推出的基礎模型 Muse Spark 開始，標誌著 Meta 的前沿模型研發重心從 Llama 系列轉向更具備多模態能力的 Muse 系列。隨後，團隊接連推出 Voice Mode、Muse Image 與 Muse Video，全面覆蓋語音、影像與影片生成領域。
就在他宣布辭職前八天，Meta 才剛發布 Muse Spark 1.2，進一步強化了智慧代理人(Agent)能力與長程任務執行潛力。

九位數年薪爭議

關於余家輝的待遇，市場曾盛傳 Meta 以高達「1 億美元年薪」的創紀錄條件將他從 OpenAI 挖角。儘管 Meta 並未證實確切數字，但 CTO Andrew Bosworth曾針對市場傳言澄清，所謂的高額報酬並非一次性領取的簽約獎金，而是包含股票、獎金與績效條件的四年期總酬勞方案。
針對這種重金挖角的現象，OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 曾評論認為：「傳教士最終會擊敗僱傭兵(Missionaries will eventually beat the mercenaries)」。
隨著余家輝在短期內完成階段性任務後離職創業，科技作者 Gergely Orosz 指出，Meta 內部的組織重組與效率調整導致工程師產生不安感，許多資深專家開始對外部機會保持開放態度。

Meta 面臨人才流失挑戰

關於創業動向，余家輝並未透露新公司的細節，僅表示一個「對人類未來極其重要，但目前尚未被充分探索的問題」正吸引著他全部的注意力。
研究平台 alphaXiv 數據顯示，包含余家輝在內，Meta 已流失超過 200 名知名研究員，總計有 929 位研究人員處於「曾在 Meta 工作但已離職」的狀態。雖然 Meta 能夠透過短期高額報酬追趕技術差距，但如何修復組織信任並留住頂尖人才，仍是未來的重要挑戰。

items.title: 巴菲特指標飆至238%歷史新高 但美股照漲不誤
paras: 美股標普500指數漲勢未歇，截至 8 月 12 日，今年已創造 14% 的總報酬，這還是在 2025 年 18% 的強勁漲幅，以及前兩年的雙位數增長之後的表現。然而，在投資大眾慶祝獲利的同時，市場估值指標正發出前所未有的警號。
由波克夏·海瑟威(Berkshire Hathaway)前執行長華倫·巴菲特(Warren Buffett)提出的「巴菲特指標」，正處於令人不安的高點。

什麼是巴菲特指標？

巴菲特指標於 2001 年首度被提及，其計算方式是將美國股市的總市值除以美國的GDP。這項指標就像是針對整個國家經濟與股市的「本益比」(P/E ratio)，被視為衡量市場估值的重要量規。
目前，巴菲特指標已攀升至 238% 的歷史新高，意味著股市總價值已高達美國經濟規模的 2.4 倍。若以 100% 為合理估值的基準線，當前的讀數顯然暗示市場正處於隨時可能破裂的泡沫之中。

指標的局限性與當前市場現實

儘管數值驚人，但這一指標近年來局限性愈加明顯。首先，許多美國大型企業擁有龐大的跨國業務，其獲利高度依賴全球市場，而不僅僅是美國本土，這會導致此比率被放大。
另外，2026 年的市場結構已與往昔大不相同。以技術密集型為主的企業主導了市場，這些公司即便規模龐大，仍能保持快速增長並擁有強大的競爭優勢，且許多企業正處於人工智慧(AI)熱潮的核心，這可能成為未來主要的成長催化劑。

歷史教訓：為何不應嘗試「擇時交易」

面對極高的估值，投資人往往會產生賣出離場、等待修正再重新買入的念頭。然而，歷史數據顯示這種「擇時交易」極具風險。
回顧過去十年的數據，儘管十年前巴菲特指標已達 121%(在當時被視為極其昂貴)，但 S&P 500 指數隨後仍創造了 318% 的總報酬。當時因為擔憂估值而清空投資組合的投資人，錯失了整整十年的豐厚收益。

專家建議：保持耐心，待在市場

據《The Motley Fool》報導指出，在巴菲特指標高達 238% 的當下，投資人最明智的舉動並非驚慌拋售，而是避免嘗試預測進場與出場時機。雖然高估值令人不安，但長期投資成功的核心原則是「待在市場的時間」而非「擇時能力」。
報導稱，雖然無法保證未來的十年能複製過去的表現，但在股市中，耐心往往會得到回報。面對高漲的行情，保持原有策略、持續留在市場中，才是獲取長期成功的關鍵。

items.title: 標普500再創歷史新高 20大功臣出爐、SanDisk暴漲逾5倍居冠
paras: 標普500指數周四(13日)再創歷史新高，盤中一度攀上7,816.70點，突破8月5日寫下的7,793.68點前高，當日上漲0.6%，今年迄今累計漲幅擴大至13.5%。推升大盤創高背後，除了多數成分股參與漲勢，一批漲幅驚人的強勢股更成為本輪行情重要推手。
今年標普500漲勢具有一定廣度，500檔成分股中已有350檔上漲，但領漲力道仍集中在部分個股。尤其半導體、資料儲存、伺服器及AI硬體相關企業表現突出，其中SanDisk今年迄今暴漲559.7%，漲幅超過5倍，居所有標普500成分股之冠。

半導體設備股也沒有缺席，應用材料、泰瑞達與科林研發今年漲幅均超過一倍。此外，資安業者Palo Alto Networks、Fortinet，以及能源股馬拉松石油、Valero Energy也進入前20名，顯示本輪漲勢並非完全侷限於單一產業。
在標普500今年上漲13.5%、持續刷新歷史高點之際，這20檔個股漲幅最低也接近翻倍，成為今年美股多頭行情中最突出的領漲族群。

items.title: 次貸危機2.0？輝達5000億美元GPU算力證券化 華爾街嗅到2008年味道：離AIG時刻只差一根稻草
items.title_en: Subprime Crisis 2.0? Nvidia’s $500 Billion GPU Compute Securitisation Gives Wall Street a Taste of 2008: Only a Straw Away from an AIG Moment
paras: 輝達再次傳出將資料中心資產證券化的計畫，這筆可能高達數千億美元的交易，正將全球AI算力熱潮推向一個危險的新階段。
彭博宏觀策略師Simon White出具最新研報直言，輝達打算將資料中心轉化為可投資資產的架構，恐致AI算力領域出現嚴重產能過剩，尤其是在「基於結果定價」模式逐漸成為行業標準的背景下。這一判斷核心邏輯令人不寒而慄，因金融化正在人為放大需求信號，掩蓋市場供過於求的真實狀況，運作機制與2008年金融危機前的房市泡沫如出一轍。
White分析指出，輝達此次與Apollo、Brookfield、KKR、黑石、貝萊德及高盛達成的合作框架，意在撬動逾5000億美元資本流入所謂的「AI工廠」。更關鍵的是，輝達將為部分交易中最高25%的GPU抵押品提供保險，實質上為其回收價值提供支撐。這與當年AIG為CDO優先級別債券出售保險、讓銀行得以減少資本佔用，並分發更多有毒債務的歷史軌跡高度吻合，最終在相關性驟升時逼的國家出手相救。
White更將此比作「GPU債券市場的AIG時刻」。他指出，這場AI基礎設施熱潮在規模上已超越1960年代的美國州際公路建設與2000年代的寬頻鋪設，光是跟輝達交叉融資與供應商資助交易規模就高達7500億美元。
輝達執行長黃仁勳的目標很明確，也就是將「AI工廠算力」打造成一種全新的可投資資產類別。GPU支持的債務市場今年已呈爆發式增長，而此次新協議將進程推向更深層次的資產證券化與分發。合作夥伴將提供資本、基礎設施專業知識，並推動證券化流通。透過提升交易吸引力，輝達將使債務結構中的優先級別債券獲得更高信用評級。
與此同時，美國證交會(SEC)剛剛放寬了資料中心債券的證券化規則。White將此比作金融危機期間退休基金最終入場的時間點，這往往標誌著風險開始向更廣泛的負債端擴散，也是危機走向終局的起點。
表面上看，輝達的風險或許有限，但White提醒，這正是AIG當年判斷。隨著時間推移，AIG承接越來越多自認為無風險且有利可圖的義務，最終發現借款人信用壓力的相關性上升足以釀成災難。
需求方面，White指出衡量標準本身正在發生根本性轉變。GPU租賃的標準計量單位是每小時成本，推理環節則是處理每個token的成本，但對終端用戶真正重要的是輸出結果。智能成本正在下降，但這一變化未立即反映在GPU層面的定價上。若一個模型能用少10倍的token完成同樣任務，而GPU的每token定價不變，那麼每塊GPU的實際效率就相當於提升10倍。
隨著「token最大化」成為歷史，模型在處理同一任務時token用量可大幅波動的證據不斷湧現，加之大模型可被輕易調整以消耗更多token，基於結果的定價模式正日益受到企業用戶的青睞。這一趨勢一旦成為主流，將對模型提供商形成壓力，推動其減少token消耗，進而壓低GPU租賃僲格。
同樣值得關注的是，GPU實質利用率據悉嚴重偏低。根據Cast AI的報告，GPU平均利用率僅為5%，ClearML則發現近半數企業正為閒置晶片浪費「數百萬美元」。這些被金融鍊金術掩蓋的供需失衡信號，恐怕很難在資本狂潮中引起重視。
面對上述效率提升的論據，AI資本支出多頭經常用來反駁的便是傑文斯悖論(Jevons paradox)：算力驅動的智能成本下降，將不可避免地推動需求上升，以量補價。
但White認為，傑文斯悖論無法在所有時間維度上持續奏效。而對市場而言，路徑依賴才是關鍵。他判斷，在當前大模型主導的AI發展階段，智能需求(而非token需求)在現行價格水準上的增速，遲早會放緩到足以引發算力成本長期下行的程度。
作為貸款方，當抵押品相關性開始惡化，借款人的信用狀況也同步走弱時，風險將迅速累積，屆時輝達將不得不履行其保險義務，而與此同時，輝達自身融資的其他交易也可能出現問題，更不用說其核心產品價值的下滑。
此外，Google等同樣以自身資產負債表為這場資本支出熱潮提供支撐的企業，也面臨類似風險。根據2008年房市危機經驗，相關性一旦啟動，便不會停下來等人。
White在報告中的結論是，輝達此次擬議交易，只是讓市場距離再次目睹這一金融自然力量又近了一步。
paras_en: Nvidia is again rumored to be planning to securitise its data‑center assets, a deal that could be worth several hundred billion dollars and is pushing the global AI compute boom into a dangerous new phase.

Bloomberg macro strategist Simon White’s latest research paper bluntly states that Nvidia intends to turn its data centres into investable assets, a move that could create a severe overcapacity in AI compute, especially as a “result‑based pricing” model is becoming the industry norm. The core logic is chilling: financialisation is artificially amplifying demand signals and masking the true oversupply, a mechanism that mirrors the housing bubble before the 2008 financial crisis.

White points out that Nvidia’s partnership framework with Apollo, Brookfield, KKR, BlackRock, Blackstone and Goldman Sachs is designed to pull more than $500 billion of capital into so‑called “AI factories.” More crucially, Nvidia will provide insurance for up to 25% of the GPU collateral in some transactions, effectively supporting the recovery value. This is strikingly similar to how AIG insured senior‑tranche CDO bonds back then, allowing banks to reduce capital charges and distribute more toxic debt, ultimately prompting a government rescue when correlations spiked.

White likens this to an “AIG moment for the GPU bond market.” He notes that the AI infrastructure boom now dwarfs the scale of 1960s U.S. interstate highway construction and 2000s broadband rollout, with cross‑financing and supplier‑backed deals with Nvidia alone reaching $750 billion.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s goal is clear: to turn “AI‑factory compute” into a brand‑new investable asset class. The GPU‑backed debt market has exploded this year, and the new agreements push the process deeper into securitisation and distribution. Partners will supply capital, infrastructure expertise and help circulate the securities, boosting the appeal of the deals and giving higher‑rated senior bonds better credit ratings.

At the same time, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has just loosened the rules for securitising data‑center bonds. White compares this to the moment pension funds entered the market during the financial crisis, a signal that risk is spreading to a broader liability side and that the crisis is moving toward its climax.

On the surface Nvidia’s risk may appear limited, but White warns that this is exactly the judgment AIG made back then. Over time AIG took on more and more obligations it thought were risk‑free and profitable, only to discover that rising borrower‑credit correlation was enough to trigger disaster.

On the demand side White says the measurement standard itself is undergoing a fundamental shift. GPU leasing is priced per hour, while the cost of inference is measured per token, yet end‑users care about the output result. Intelligent‑cost is falling, but this change is not immediately reflected in GPU‑level pricing. If a model can complete the same task with ten‑times fewer tokens while the per‑token GPU price stays unchanged, the effective efficiency of each GPU rises tenfold.

As “token maximisation” becomes a thing of the past, evidence is mounting that token usage for the same task can vary wildly, and large models can be easily tweaked to consume more tokens. Result‑based pricing is gaining traction among enterprise users. Once this becomes mainstream it will pressure model providers to cut token consumption, thereby driving down GPU‑leasing rates.

Equally noteworthy is that actual GPU utilisation is reportedly very low. Cast AI reports an average utilisation of only 5%, and ClearML finds that nearly half of firms are wasting “hundreds of millions of dollars” on idle chips. These supply‑demand imbalances, hidden by financial alchemy, are unlikely to attract attention amid the capital frenzy.
When faced with arguments about efficiency gains, AI‑capex bulls often invoke Jevons paradox: lower intelligent‑cost from more compute inevitably spurs higher demand, offsetting price declines.

White argues that Jevons paradox cannot hold indefinitely across all time horizons. For the market, path dependence is key. He judges that in the current large‑model‑driven AI era, the growth rate of intelligent‑demand (not token‑demand) at today’s price levels will eventually slow enough to trigger a long‑term decline in compute costs.

As a lender, when the correlation of the collateral deteriorates and the borrower’s credit weakens simultaneously, risk will accumulate rapidly. Nvidia would then have to honour its insurance obligations, and other financing deals could also falter, not to mention a potential decline in the value of its core products.

Moreover, companies like Google that are also using their balance sheets to fuel this cap‑ex boom face similar risks. History from the 2008 housing crisis shows that once correlation starts, it does not pause for anyone.
White concludes that Nvidia’s proposed transaction simply brings the market one step closer to witnessing this natural financial force in action again.

items.title: 營收上看5000億美元！馬斯克再發豪語： 2027年底xAI資料中心供電容量衝上10GW
items.title_en: Revenue to Look at $50 Billion! Musk Again Makes a Bold Statement: 10GW AI Data Center Power Capacity to Reach 10GW by End of 2027
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，全球首富馬斯克在SpaceX員工會議上透露，旗下 SpaceXAI(原xAI)資料中心電力容量預計明年底前擴大約 7倍，達到10GW，較目前孟菲斯與南海文(Southaven)兩處合計1.4GW暴增逾 6 倍，相當於約1.5 年內完成此一躍進。
美國科技媒體《Tom's Hardware》週四(13日)報導指出，馬斯克在員工大會上宣稱，SpaceXAI已建成「全球最強AI訓練聚落」，並打算明年底前將其規模擴至當前約10 倍。
根據馬斯克估算，若每瓦價值約30至50美元且10GW AI 算力如期上線，xAI每年可創造3000億至5000億美元收入。
不過，業界提醒，資料中心以GW描述供電容量不等於實際算力，冷卻、照明、供配電、網路、儲存與伺服器等系統均會消耗電力，實際可用於運算的比例需視整體基礎設施效率而定。
分析人士指出，馬斯克的擴張藍圖若成真，將使xAI躍居全球AI基礎設施頂尖行列，但也代表著龐大的資本支出與能源挑戰。10GW供電規模約等同於多座大型核電廠的輸出，電力取得、散熱技術與供應鏈排程將是決定這項野心能否落地的關鍵變數，市場後續將密切關注其融資動向與實際建置進度。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from foreign media, the world's richest man, Musk, revealed at a SpaceX employee conference that the power capacity of the SpaceX AI (formerly xAI) data center is expected to expand by approximately 7 times by the end of next year, reaching 10GW, which is more than 6 times the current combined capacity of Memphis and Southaven, equivalent to completing this leap in about 1.5 years.

US tech media Tom's Hardware reported on Thursday (13th) that Musk claimed at the employee conference that SpaceX AI has built the 'world's strongest AI training cluster' and plans to expand its scale to about 10 times the current scale by the end of next year.

According to Musk's estimate, if each watt is valued at around $30 to $50 and the 10GW AI computing power is put into operation as scheduled, xAI can generate $30 billion to $50 billion in revenue per year.

However, the industry reminds that describing the power capacity of the data center in GW does not equal the actual computing power, and the cooling, lighting, power distribution, network, storage, and server systems will all consume electricity, and the actual usable proportion for computation needs to be determined by the overall infrastructure efficiency.

Analysts point out that if Musk's expansion plan comes true, xAI will become the world's leading AI infrastructure, but it also represents a massive capital expenditure and energy challenge. The 10GW power scale is equivalent to the output of multiple large nuclear power plants, and the acquisition of power, heat dissipation technology, and supply chain scheduling will be the key variables that determine whether this ambitious plan can be implemented, and the market will closely follow its financing trends and actual construction progress.

items.title: 超越美光與AMD！戴爾今年股價狂飆285% 美超微亮眼財報指引新榮景
items.title_en: Dell Surpasses Intel and AMD! Dell's Stock Price Soars 285% This Year, Micron Shines in Earnings Report
paras: 戴爾科技(DELL-US)股價今年來累計大漲285%，遠勝市場熱議的人工智慧(AI)建設概念股，瑞穗交易部門分析師Jordan Klein形容其股價表現「瘋狂」，並指出，戴爾股價漲幅已超越「幾乎所有大型科技股」。
受到投資人追捧的美光(MU-US)今年來累計上漲219%，而超微(AMD-US)超微也有126%的漲幅，但都還追不上戴爾。戴爾周四再度收紅，上漲2.1%至每股494.51美元。
香港個人電腦及伺服器製造商聯想集團(Lenovo)(00992-HK)周四公布亮眼財報，調整後獲利大增176%，營收成長43%，該公司把強勁的成長歸因於市場對AI基礎設施需求持續增加。
財報顯示，聯想上季包含AI優化伺服器及個人電腦在內的AI相關營收較去年同期成長60%，目前已占公司總營收的35%。
聯想的財報公布前，美超微(Super Micro Computer)(SMCI-US)周二也發布財報，並給出優於華爾街預期的營收展望。投資人同樣對美超微獲利能力改善感到樂觀，上季調整後毛利率達17.6%，超過原估區間8.2%至8.4%的兩倍以上。
瑞穗的Klein表示，美超微的財報對待爾來說是「非常重要的領先指標」。戴爾預定9月公布財報，他預期AI及企業業務將優於市場預期，並預估總營收成長率將達50-60%**。
美超微周二盤後公布財報後，周三收盤大漲19%，帶動整體半導體類股上揚。新型雲端服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US)以及光學元件製造商Lumentum Holdings(LITE-US)周二也公布優於預期的財報，進一步提振市場對AI投資概念股的樂觀情緒。
美超微與CoreWeave均指出，未完成訂單持續增加，反映客戶對AI硬體的需求仍然強勁。
美超微上月發布初步財報時曾表示，上季的新訂單金額突破600億美元，使2026會計年度的未完成訂單創下歷史新高。
paras_en: Dell Technologies (DELL-US) stock price has surged 285% this year, far surpassing market hype on artificial intelligence (AI) construction concept stocks. Analyst Jordan Klein from RBC's trading department described the stock price performance as 'crazy' and pointed out that Dell's stock price surge has surpassed 'almost all major tech stocks'.

Dell has been favored by investors, with its stock price rising 219% this year, while Micron (MU-US) has seen a 126% surge, but still trails behind Dell. Dell rose 2.1% to $494.51 per share on Thursday.

Lenovo (00992-HK), a Hong Kong-based personal computer and server manufacturer, reported an impressive earnings report on Thursday, with adjusted profits increasing 176% and revenue growth of 43%. The company attributed its strong growth to the continued increase in demand for AI infrastructure.

The report showed that Lenovo's AI-related revenue, including AI-optimized servers and personal computers, grew 60% year-over-year in the previous quarter, accounting for 35% of the company's total revenue.

Before Lenovo's earnings report, Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) released its earnings report on Tuesday, exceeding Wall Street's expectations with its revenue outlook. Investors are also optimistic about Micron's improved profitability, with an adjusted gross margin of 17.6% in the previous quarter, more than twice the estimated range of 8.2% to 8.4%.

RBC's Klein stated that Micron's earnings report is 'very important leading indicator' for Dell. Dell is expected to release its earnings report in September, with Klein predicting that AI and enterprise businesses will exceed market expectations, with a total revenue growth rate of 50-60%.

After Micron released its earnings report on Tuesday, it surged 19% on Wednesday, driving the overall semiconductor sector up. CoreWeave (CRWV-US), a new cloud service provider, and Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US), a manufacturer of optical components, also released earnings reports that exceeded expectations on Tuesday, further boosting market sentiment on AI investment concept stocks.
Micron and CoreWeave both pointed out that the number of uncompleted orders continues to increase, reflecting strong demand from customers for AI hardware.

Micron reported in its preliminary earnings report last month that the value of new orders in the previous quarter exceeded $60 billion, setting a new historical high for uncompleted orders in the 2026 fiscal year.

items.title: 川普對無人機徵收100%關稅 料加深美中科技脫鉤
items.title_en: Trump Imposes 100% Tariff on Drones, Likely Deepening US-China Tech Decoupling
paras: 川普政府周四(13日)宣布，將對進口無人機及其零部件徵收最高達 100% 的關稅。此舉被視為美國減少對外國供應商依賴、保護本土產業的重大升級，並可能加速美中兩國在無人機供應鏈上的「脫鉤」進程。
根據白宮公告，這項關稅政策採取分級制：重量超過 25 公斤或具備特定性能的重型無人機將面臨 100% 的最高稅率；較小型的無人機則徵收 25% 的關稅。
為了鞏固與盟友的關係，美國對特定貿易夥伴提供了優惠：來自歐盟、日本、瑞士及台灣的無人機，若硬體與技術皆源自當地或美國，稅率將降至 15%，而英國則適用 10% 的稅率。多數關稅將在簽署後 21 天內生效，部分非敏感零部件則有 180 天的緩衝期。
此次決策是依據《1962年貿易擴張法》第 232 條，以國家安全為由發起調查後制定的。商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)指出，美國對外國無人機系統的依賴已達「實質性」程度，對國家安全構成風險。
川普在公告中強調，無人機系統對美國的國家與經濟安全至關重要。特別是俄烏戰爭充分展現了無人機在現代混合戰爭中的軍事效能，促使華府更具緊迫感地去扶持國內產業，避免在關鍵技術上受制於人。
雖然官方聲明未直接點名中國，但目標顯然直指全球最大的無人機製造國。在此之前，聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)已採取行動阻止大疆創新(DJI)等新機型進口，大疆去年曾占據美國 70% 的商用市場。專家分析，美中雙方正滑向特定類型無人機的「硬脫鉤」，這已成為兩國在基本貿易協定下持續進行低層級對抗的一部分。
受此政策激勵，美國本土無人機製造商如 AeroVironment 與 Aevex Corp 的股價在消息公布後大幅跳升。然而，中國方面也已展開反擊，對軍用無人機及關鍵技術實施「逐案審查」的出口管制。
paras_en: The Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 13th) that it will levy tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and their components. The move is seen as a major upgrade in the United States’ effort to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and protect domestic industry, and it could accelerate the “decoupling” of the US and China in the drone supply chain.

According to the White House announcement, the tariff policy uses a tiered system: heavy drones weighing more than 25 kilograms or possessing certain capabilities will face the maximum 100% rate, while smaller drones will be subject to a 25% tariff.

To strengthen ties with allies, the United States is offering preferential rates for specific trading partners: drones from the EU, Japan, Switzerland and Taiwan that are wholly sourced in hardware and technology from the local market or the United States will see the rate reduced to 15%, and the United Kingdom will receive a 10% rate. Most tariffs will take effect within 21 days of signing, with a 180‑day grace period for certain non‑sensitive components.

The decision is based on Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, invoked on national‑security grounds after an investigation. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said U.S. reliance on foreign drone systems has reached a “substantial” level that poses a risk to national security.

In the announcement, Trump stressed that drone systems are critical to America’s national and economic security. The Russia‑Ukraine war has highlighted the military effectiveness of drones in modern hybrid warfare, giving Washington a heightened sense of urgency to support domestic producers and avoid dependence on critical technology.

Although the official statement did not name China directly, the target is clearly the world’s largest drone manufacturer. Previously, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) moved to block new models from DJI and other firms; DJI accounted for about 70% of the U.S. commercial drone market last year. Experts say the U.S. and China are moving toward a “hard decoupling” of certain drone types, becoming part of a low‑level confrontation that persists despite broader trade agreements.

The policy spurred a sharp rise in the share prices of U.S. drone makers such as AeroVironment and Aevex Corp after the news broke. China, meanwhile, has begun retaliating with case‑by‑case export controls on military drones and key technologies.

items.title: 〈台幣〉一度升破32元大關 收32.046元 強升1.22角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Briefly Broke the 32‑Per‑Dollar Barrier, Closing at 32.046, a Strong Rise of 1.22 Cents
paras: 新台幣今(14)日再度呈現強升格局，全日處升值態勢，更一度升破32元大關，終場收在32.046元，升值1.22角，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.28億美元。
新台幣今日以32.15元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.991元，全日高低價差1.59元。
觀察主要亞幣，新台幣收升0.38%，韓元也升值逾0.3%，日元升近0.2%，人民幣、星元小升約0.05%上下，泰銖則小貶0.05%。
統一投顧表示，美國 7 月 CPI 月增 0.1%，符合市場預期，而核心PPI 月增 0.2%，則低於市場預期的 0.3%，進一步緩解市場對聯準會 9 月升息的擔憂。
元大投顧則指出，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外下滑，且最新 CPI 數據如常，使市場擔憂升息程度減輕不少，預期 8 月底全球央行年會前聯準會不至於出現過於鷹派的言論。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar again showed a strong upward trend today (the 14th), staying in appreciation mode throughout the day and at one point breaking the 32‑per‑dollar mark, ultimately closing at 32.046, a gain of 1.22 cents, with the Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage’s transaction volume expanding to US$2.228 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.15, up 0.18 cents, and rose to a high of 31.991 during the session, with a daily price range of 1.59 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.38%, the Korean won also appreciated by more than 0.3%, the Japanese yen rose nearly 0.2%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each inched up about 0.05%, while the Thai baht slipped about 0.05%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that U.S. CPI for July rose 0.1% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations, while core PPI rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, below the expected 0.3%, further easing concerns about a September rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

Yuanta Investment Advisory pointed out that U.S. non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly fell in July and the latest CPI data came in as expected, reducing market worries about the extent of future rate hikes, and they anticipate that the Fed is unlikely to adopt an overly hawkish tone before the global central‑bank meetings at the end of August.

items.title: 干預越多、空頭笑越大聲！高盛：日本15年來最大干預引發日元套利部位大幅平倉
items.title_en: Intervention Fuels Short Selling as Goldman Sachs Sees Largest Intervention in 15 Years
paras: 高盛週五(14日)出具研究報告指出，日本15年來最大規模的外匯干預，非但沒能扭轉日元頹勢，反而替市場「創造了更高價位拋售日元」的戰術窗口。
美日兩國上月底罕見聯手買入日元，一度將美元兌日元從逼近163拉回155附近，但不到兩週便再度滑向160大關，今日日圓兌美元在亞洲匯市早盤報159.46。
高盛策略師Karen Reichgott Fishman表示，此次干預引發的戰術性日元套利平倉規模，已超過2024年7月那輪干預後的初期平倉量。若宏觀環境轉向支撐日元，部位甚至可能翻為淨多頭，重演2024年夏天的劇本，但當前日美利差仍大，日本利率僅約1%，遠低於多數發達經濟體，借低利日元、買高息資產的套利交易利潤空間依舊誘人。
另據摩根大通與道富數據，截至8月4日，避險基金已砍掉一半看空日元押注，但部分資金正回流套利池。
Alpha Binwani Capital創辦人Ashwin Binwani說：「干預給了我們在更好價位賣日元的絕佳機會，套利交易太香了，不能錯過。」
道富東京分行經理Bart Wakabayashi也表示，實錢帳戶仍保留套利持倉，日元兌澳元、歐元、美元、加元、英鎊皆被持續賣出。今年做空日元兌哥倫比亞比索、土耳其里拉、挪威克朗的組合報酬率均超過10%。
當前風險在於，空頭回補越積越多，官方再度出手機率同步攀升。過去一週日元已吐回干預帶來的一半左右升幅，財政壓力與利差因素未消除前，160關卡仍是市場與東京當局的敏感紅線。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs released a research report on Friday (14th) stating that Japan's largest foreign exchange intervention in 15 years has not only failed to reverse the yen's decline, but has instead created a higher price point for selling yen.

The US and Japan jointly purchased yen at the end of last month, temporarily pushing the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 163 to around 155, but it slid back to the 160 level in less than two weeks. The yen-dollar exchange rate in Asian markets opened at 159.46 today.

Goldman Sachs strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman stated that the tactical yen short selling scale triggered by this intervention has exceeded the initial scale of short selling after the intervention in July 2024. If the macro environment turns to support the yen, the position may even turn into a net long position, replaying the script from the summer of 2024, but the current US-Japan interest rate difference is still large, and Japan's interest rate is only around 1%, far lower than most developed economies, making the low-yen, high-yield asset trading profit space still attractive.
According to data from Morgan Stanley and UBS, as of August 4, hedge funds have cut their yen short selling bets by half, but some funds are returning to the arbitrage pool.
Alpha Binwani Capital founder Ashwin Binwani said, 'The intervention gave us an excellent opportunity to sell yen at a better price, and the arbitrage trading is too tempting to miss.'

UBS Tokyo branch manager Bart Wakabayashi also stated that real money accounts still hold arbitrage positions, and yen against Australian dollar, euro, US dollar, Canadian dollar, and British pound are being continuously sold. The return on investment for short selling yen against Colombian peso, Turkish lira, and Norwegian krone this year has all exceeded 10%.

The current risk is that the short selling rebound will accumulate more and more, and the official intervention will increase in probability. The yen has already recovered about half of the upward momentum brought by the intervention in the past week, and the fiscal pressure and interest rate factors have not been eliminated, so the 160 level is still a sensitive red line for the market and the Tokyo authorities.

items.title_en: NY Forex: PPI Flat Eases Fed Rate‑Hike Bets, Dollar Mixed vs Major Currencies
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周四(13日)漲跌互見，最新數據顯示美國生產者價格指數(PPI)持平，使交易員進一步下修聯準會(Fed)9月升息的機率。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)微漲0.02%，約報99.96。PPI公布前報99.80。
美國7月PPI持平，低於市場所估的攀升0.2%，6月數據修正為下滑0.1%。
道富(State Street)資深總經策略師Noel Dixon說，本月稍晚另將公布個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，從組成PCE的項目來看，這份報告「應該會相當不錯」。
他說：「我從這個數字和昨天的數字中得出的結論是，這有助於證明Fed在9月維持利率不變的合理性。」
聯邦資金利率期貨顯示，Fed 9月升息機率為35%，低於周三的40%和一周前的55%。
美元兌歐元略升0.03%至1.1528。
交易員一直在觀察Fed是否需要升息，以抑制目前仍持續高於2%目標的通膨綠，同時，伊朗對荷姆茲海峽的掌控仍在牽動油價。
稍早有報導披露，葉門青年運動(Houthis)無人機鎖定了沙烏地阿拉伯石油公司(Saudi Aramco)的煉油廠，國際油價周四稍早一度上漲逾3%，但之後收復部分失土，跌幅收斂至不到1%。
美國周四公布的其他數據顯示，上周首次申請失業救濟金的人數微幅增加，代表儘管7月非農就業人口意外減少，勞動力市場依然穩定。周五將公布的離零售數據將再次呈現美國經濟的強弱。
日元兌美元微貶0.04%至159.48。目前日元已經回吐上個月美日歷史性聯合干預帶來的部分漲幅。當時的干預行動曾讓市場加碼押注日本銀行(央行，BOJ)可能需要加速進一步升息。
Dixon說：「我不認為這已經嚇退投資人繼續押注日元走弱，除非日銀在9月會議上採取行動，並釋出更偏鷹派的政策指引。」
英鎊下跌0.08%至1.3481美元。英國經濟6月意外成長0.3%，主要受能源價格下滑、世界盃開打及炎熱天氣帶動。
挪威克朗走弱，報9.51美元。先前挪威央行如市場預期維持利率不變，但同時表示近期通膨已有所降溫。
挪威目前利率為4.25%，在全球10個已開發經濟體中名列前茅，加上挪威身為石油與天然氣出口國，今年以來也受到油氣產業支撐，帶動挪威克朗走強。

paras_en: The dollar was mixed against major currencies on Thursday (the 13th) as the latest data showed the U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) held steady, prompting traders to further lower the probability of a Fed rate hike in September.
In the New York close, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, edged up 0.02% to about 99.96, after standing at 99.80 before the PPI release.
July's U.S. PPI was flat, below the market’s expectation of a 0.2% rise, and June’s data were revised to a 0.1% decline.

State Street senior chief economist Noel Dixon said that later this month the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index will be released, and based on its components the report “should be fairly solid.”
He added, “My takeaway from this number and yesterday’s figure is that it supports the case for the Fed keeping rates unchanged in September.”
Federal funds futures show a 35% chance of a September Fed hike, down from 40% on Wednesday and 55% a week earlier.
The dollar was up 0.03% against the euro, trading at 1.1528.
Traders have been watching whether the Fed needs to raise rates to curb inflation that remains above the 2% target, while Iran’s control of the Hormuz Strait continues to influence oil prices.

Earlier reports disclosed that Houthi drones targeted a Saudi Aramco refinery; international oil prices rose more than 3% on Thursday before retracing some gains and ending with a decline of less than 1%.

Other U.S. data released on Thursday showed a slight increase in initial unemployment claims, indicating that despite an unexpected drop in July non‑farm payrolls, the labor market remains stable. Retail data due on Friday will again test the strength of the U.S. economy.

The yen slipped 0.04% to 159.48 per dollar. It has given back part of the gains from last month’s historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention, which had led markets to bet that the Bank of Japan might need to accelerate further rate hikes.
Dixon said, “I don’t think this has scared investors away from betting on a weaker yen unless the BOJ takes action at its September meeting and signals a more hawkish stance.”
The pound fell 0.08% to $1.3481. The UK economy grew unexpectedly by 0.3% in June, driven mainly by lower energy prices, the World Cup kickoff, and hot weather.
The Norwegian krone weakened to $9.51. The Norges Bank, as markets expected, left rates unchanged but noted that inflation has started to cool.

Norway’s policy rate is 4.25%, among the highest in the ten advanced economies, and as an oil and gas exporter the country has been supported by the energy sector this year, which has bolstered the krone.
